text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A court bid by seven consulting firms to have construction firm Stocks and Stocks' tender for a new government office park set aside has been postponed.
- Namibia's hotel industry has reacted angrily to plans by the Ministry of Environment and Tourism to deregulate the accommodation sector.
- National carrier Air Namibia and German airline Lufthansa are discussing various options for possible cooperation, Trans Namib Ltd said.
